supersession_note.reason: Read-only preflight showed the checkpoint selected in v1 is the standard-LR base-initialized single-task model whose five init3/seed12348 repeats were all failures. It is not the 5/5 current-pipeline single-task reference. V1 also confused evaluator CLI seed with the effective seed; the evaluator adds init_index internally. No rollout was launched under v1.

trigger: The matched 4-task diagnostic completed 89 rollouts but failed its predeclared progression gate: task0 fixed-init3 repeats were 4/5. The historical single-task fixed-init3 reference was 5/5 under recorded seed 12348, while the joint-4 repeats used seed 12351; those rates are not seed-matched.

options_compared.reason: The four-task progression gate did not pass; increasing task count would violate the staged decision rule and confound task interference with unresolved repeatability.

A matched task-1-only control may later help distinguish task difficulty from multi-task interference, but the evaluator/positive-control comparison should first be aligned on the exact initialization and seed as advised by the supervisor.

This is the smallest direct check of the known-good single-task checkpoint under the same task, benchmark initialization, seed, action horizon, evaluator, and V3 protocol as the joint-4 fixed-init repeats. It directly resolves the recorded-seed mismatch without training or changing the official benchmark.
The remaining read-only-comparison-cost diagnostic is small, directly addresses the supervisor's first control, and is authorized by the unattended project goal.

selected_protocol.protocol_note: Same native V3 evaluator/protocol as the joint-4 corrected evaluation; deterministic-algorithm strict mode is not enabled. Each repeat must write to a unique subdirectory.

interpretation_limits: Five repeats at one initialization are a repeatability diagnostic, not a generalization estimate.
A difference of one success between model groups is not by itself evidence of a reliable performance difference.
This diagnostic cannot unlock Fold02 or change the formal LIBERO-36 result.
Do not start task-count scaling or retraining from this result alone; compare the complete paired evidence and select a next stage explicitly within the long-term goal.
